dedupe_keys.name: ogc api nrw de earthquake hazard datasets

description: ogc-api.nrw.de: earthquake hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc-api.nrw.de. Coverage: the area served by ogc-api.nrw.de. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about earthquake hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: EAS NRW OGC-API Features - Seismologische Stationen in Nordrhein-Westf; Seismik NRW OGC-API Features - Seismische Untersuchungen in Nordrhein-; Seiskat NRW OGC-API Features - Katalog der Erdbebenereignisse in Nordr. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply), Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
